out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION. HAVE MULTIPLE STAFF MEMBERS BECOME A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATE. Brx Oven (Inspection Date: 09/08/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink BY THE ESPRESSO MACHINE being used AS A DUMP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO STOP DUMPING WATER IN THE HANDSINK. STAFF MOVE THE GELETO CONTAINER TO THE DISH PIT. HAND SINKS ARE FOR HAND WASHING ONLY.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) cooked ground beef 2) house dressing
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. STAFF DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS. SEE DATE MARKING HAND OUT.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: 1) cooked bell peppers 2) cooked ground beef 3) chopped chicken
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC AND STAFF TO ALWAYS WRTITE THE DATE THAT THE TCS FOOD WAS PREPARED. USE OR DISCARD WITHIN 7 DAY. SEE DATE MARKING HAND OUT.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: 1) on the brunch menu, “eggs any style” were observed missing a consumer advisory
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PIC UPDATED THE MENU DURING THE INSPECTION TO REFLECT THE CORRECT CONSUMER ADVISORIES.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage Prohibited under Condensation
violations.observation: Observed covered foods being stored under the dripping condensation in the walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food may not be stored under water lines where water has condensed. DO NOT STORE FOODS UNDER DRIPPING CONDENSATION. MOVE FOOD OR FIX THE COOLER. CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) utensils were observed being stored in a container of hot water on the flat top. Hot water was observed at 121f 2) gelato scoops were being stored in a container of water at ambient temperature.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. UTENSILS WERE TAKEN TO THE DISH PIT. DO NOT STORE UTENSILS IN AMBIENT TEMPERATURE WATER. WATER MUST BE 135f FOR PROPER STORAGE.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: 1) container of balsamic glaze
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. STAFF COVERED THE CONTAINER WITH PLASTIC WRAP. Brx Oven (Inspection Date: 03/23/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) at ambient temperature, garlic oil was observed at 70f; 2) in the cold rail, chopped chicken at 43f, roasted eggplant at 49f, chopped meatballs 43f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE FOOD.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed an unlabeled spray bottle of bleach being stored in the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. STAFF LABLED THE SPRAY BOTTLE

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: multiple squeeze bottles of sauces and oils
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. LABEL ALL SQUEEZE BOTTLES

violations.corrective_action: Food may not be stored under water lines where water has condensed. ADDRESS CONDENSATION DRIPPING ON FOOD. REPAIR COOLER OR RELOCATE FOOD TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Food debris and grease was observed accumulated on the interior of the microwave and exterior of the microwave and oven.
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. THOROUGHLY CLEAN THESE PIECES OF EQUIPMENT. ROUTINE CLEANING IS REQUIRED.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed the wall behind the cookline with dripping grease deposits.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. MORE FREQUENT ROUTINE CLEANING IS REQUIRED.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation Hood, Designed to Prevent Condensate Drip
violations.observation: Grease from the exhaust hood system at the cook line was observed dripping
violations.corrective_action: Exhaust ventilation hood systems in food preparation and warewashing areas including components such as hoods, fans, guards, and ducting shall be designed to prevent grease or condensation from draining or dripping onto food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. MORE FREQUENT AND ROUTINE CLEANING IS REQUIRED. Brx Oven (Inspection Date: 09/30/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine at the bar was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE THE USE OF THIS DISH MACHINE UNTIL IT IS OPERATIONAL. ALL SANITIZING SHALL BE DONE IN THE MAIN DISH WASHER OR IN THE THREE COMPARTMENT SINK. PIC CALLED ECOLAB TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR THE MACHINE.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: meatballs in the marinara sauce was observed at 115f on the flat top.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT THE MEATBALLS IN THE MARINARA SAUCE TO 165f ON THE STOVE. AFTERWARDS, THE MEATBALLS IN THE MARINARA SAUCE CAN BE HOT HELD AT 135f. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO REMOVE THE FOOD FROM THE FLAT TOP AND REHEAT IT ON THE STOVE.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed a metal container holding utensils on the flat top full of hot water. Hot water was observed at 125f. Observed gelato scoops being held in water on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC REMOVED THE CONTAINER OF UTENSILS FROM THE FLAT TOP AND BROUGHT IT TO THE DISH MACHINE. EHS INSTRUCTED TO KEEP HOT WATER AT 135F TO STORE THE IN-USE UTENSILS AND CHANGE FREQUENTLY. ALTERNATIVELY, IN-USE UTENSILS CAN BE HELD IN A DRY CONTAINER. Brx Oven (Inspection Date: 04/18/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at NEXT TO THREE THREE-VAT SINK was blocked BY A TRASH CAN AND A CONTAINER OF MOZZARELLA IN THE SINK BASIN, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC MOVED TRASH CAN AND MOZZARELLA AND UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINKS MUST ALWAYS BE ACCESSIBLE AND SHOULD ONLY BE USED FOR HANDWASHING.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: OBSERVED RAW SALMON THAT STAFF CONFIRMED COULD BE ORDER UNDERCOOKED, BUT WERE UNABLE TO PROVIDE PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER.
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. PIC UNDERSTANDS PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER SHOULD BE PROVIDED TO EHS WITHIN 10 DAYS. Brx Oven (Inspection Date: 11/07/2024) Page 2 of 3
